alt: One class supplies shared behavior while two instances own independent lists; changing one leaves the other unchanged.
A bound method remembers its receiver: a.deposit(5) calls Account.deposit(a, 5).
Integer multiplication declines an unrelated Vector, then Python tries Vector.__rmul__; both declining causes TypeError.
The example diamond has MRO D, B, C, A, object; super inside B continues at C on a D instance.
A service delegates charging to an injected real or fake gateway without inheriting from it.
Status.PAID converts to the stored string paid through .value; Status("paid") reconstructs the enum member.
Ordinary lookup prioritizes readable data descriptors, instance data, non-data descriptors, then ordinary class attributes.
Checkout snapshots cart values; invoices read the order, remaining unaffected by later cart or catalog edits.
